description: Values of WGFT_AGENT_ALLOW_TARGETS. normalized is the list as the agent logs it at start, or null when the value means no restriction. An error case gives the parser's error; at the door of agent run it becomes the reason of "refusing to start [config WGFT_AGENT_ALLOW_TARGETS]: ERROR" with exit code 3.
